name: harmonic oscillator, the symplectic Euler assignments in the other order

claims.why: TRAP (step semantics): the invariant of symplectic Euler (p first) is not one of the method with q first (the adjoint). Exactly, 2(I(Phi(z)) - I(z)) = -2 h^2 w^2 p^2 + 2 h^2 w^4 q^2 + 4 h^3 w^4 p q + 2 h^4 w^4 p^2
by hand: q' = q + h p, p' = p - h w^2 q', so p'^2 + w^2 q'^2 + h w^2 p' q' = p^2 - h w^2 p q' + w^2 q'^2 = p^2 + w^2 q^2 + h w^2 p q (substituting q')
